title: BiPrompt: Bilateral Prompt Optimization for Visual and Textual Debiasing in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness against misleading background-object correlations using out-of-distribution datasets (e.g., Tiny-ImageNet, CUB-200) and simulated spurious-bias benchmarks (e.g., Waterbirds, CamelDeer, SpiderCrab) by measuring average and worst-group classification accuracy.

Measuring the impact of class-name priors and semantic anisotropy in text prompts by applying balanced prompt normalization and evaluating the resulting zero-shot accuracy improvements on out-of-distribution vision-language tasks.
